senses.gloss:
n. (-तं)
A hundred.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Happy, well, prosperous.
2 Feeble, thin.
3 Sharpened, whetted, sharp.
4 Handsome, bright.
n. (-तं)
Joy, pleasure, happiness.
E.
शो to reduce or diminish, aff. क्त.

f. (-त्ता)
1 Being, existence.
2 Goodness, excellence.
E.
सत् being, तल् aff. of the abstract; also सत्त्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Given.
2 Destroyed.
n. (-तं)
Pleasure, delight.
E.
सत to give, or षो to destroy, aff. क्त, form irr.: see सित.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A hundred.
m. (-कः)
A century, a cento, a collection of one hundred stanzas, &c.
E.
शत a hundred, and कन् aff.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
A Jina or Jaina pontiff of the last age.
E.
शत a hundred, and कीर्त्ति fame.

n. (-म्भं)
Gold.
m. (-म्भः)
The name of a mountain.
f. (-म्भा)
A plant, (Phyalis flexuosa.)
E.
शत a hundred, and कुम्भ a water jar.

n. (-म्भं)
Gold.
m. (-म्भः)
A plant, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
शतकुम्भ said to be the name of a mountain, and अण् aff. implying production.

m. (-टिः)
INDRA'S thunderbolt.
E.
शत a hundred, and कोटि edge.

m. (-तुः)
INDRA.
E.
शत a hundred, क्रतु sacrifice; a hundred Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of an unbroken horse, elevating the sacrificer to the place and title of INDRA.

n. (-ण्डं)
Gold.

mfn. (-गुः-गुः-गु)
Possessed of a hundred cows, with as many, &c.
E.
शत and गु for गो a cow.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
A hundred times, a hundred fold.
E.
शत, and गुण a time.

f. (-घ्नी)
1 A weapon; it is generally supposed to be a sort of fire arms, or the ancient Indian rocket, but it is also described as a stone set round with iron spikes.
2 A female scorpion.
3 A plant, (Galedupa arborea.)
4 A disease of the throat, apparently enlargement of the tonsils.
E.
शत a hundred, हन to kill, aff. अण् and ङीष्, and the radical letters changed.

m. (-दः)
The wood-pecker.
E.
शत a hundred, च्छद a feather.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Hundredth.
E.
शत a hundred, तमट् aff.

f. (-रा)
The constellation Śatabhiṣā, q. v.
E.
शत a hundred or many, and तारा a star.

f. (-द्रुः)
The Setlej river, which rises in the Himālaya mountains, in the vicinity it is supposed of the Rāvanhrad or lake, and running to the S. W.unites in the Pañjāb with the Beyah or Vipāśā, when it forms the Hyphasis of the Greeks, and falls into the Indus below Multan.
E.
शत a hundred (fold, or in a hundred branches), द्रु to flow, Uṇādi aff. कु.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Hundred-gated, having a hundred or a number of doors or outlets.
E.
शत, and द्वार a door.

f. (-घा)
Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
ind.
In a hundred ways, a hundredfold.
E.
शत a hundred (blossoms), धा to have, क and टाप् affs. or शत the same, and घाच् aff.

m. (-मा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
शत a hundred, (i. e. many,) घामन् body; being multiplied in as many shapes as the creation exhibits.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Flowing in many streams.
2 Having many edges, &c.
n. (-रं)
The thunderbolt.
E.
शत a hundred, घारा an edge, टच् added.

m. (-तिः)
1 BRAHMĀ.
2 INDRA.
E.
शत a hundred, and धृति sacrifice.

n. (-त्रं)
A lotus in general, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphæa nelumbo).
m. (-त्रः)
1 A peacock.
2 The Sāras or Indian crane.
3 A wood-pecker.
4 A parrot, the king parrot or Loory.
f. (-त्रा)
A woman.
E.
शत a hundred, पत्र a leaf or feather.

m. (-कः)
The wood-pecker.
E.
कन् added to the last, q. v.

mf. (-कः-की-कं)
Following a variety of paths or doctrines.
E.
शत a hundred, पथिन् a road and figuratively a doctrine, aff. षिकन्.

f. (-दी)
A centipede, jaulus.
E.
शत a hundred, and पद a foot, ङीष् aff.

n. (-द्मं)
The white lotus.
E.
शत a hundred (leaves), and पद्म a lotus.

m. (-र्व्वा)
A bambu.
E.
शत a hundred or many, पर्व्वन् a joint or knot.

f. (-र्व्वा)
1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
2 Orris root.
3 The wife of ŚUKRA.
4 Day of full moon in the month Āśvina.
E.
शत a hundred, पर्व्वन् a joint or period, ङीप् aff.

f. (-का)
1 Bent grass or Dūb.
2 Orris root.
3 Barley.
E.
कन् fem. form, added to the last.

m. (-शः)
The planet VENUS or its regent.
E.
शतपर्व्वा the wife of ŚUKRA, and ईश lord or husband.

f. (-पाद् or -पात्)
A centipede.
E.
शत a hundred, and पाद् a foot.

f. (-का)
1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli.
2 A centipede.
E.
शत a hundred, पाद a foot or root, कन् aff. fem. form.

m. (-ष्पः)
The poet BHĀRAVI, the author of the Kirātārjunīya.
f. (-ष्पा)
A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
शत a hundred, and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-का)
Anethum, (sowa.)
E.
कन् fem. form, added to the last.

m. (-नः)
A sieve.

m. (-कः)
Fistula in ano with many external openings.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-कः)
A kind of sugar cane.

m. (-सः)
A flower, (Nerium odorum.)
E.
शत a hundred, and प्रास a dart, to which the leaves are compared.

f. (-षक्)
One of the lunar asterisms, see the next.
E.
शत a hundred, भिषज् a physician.

f. (-षा)
The twenty-fifth of the Nakṣatras or lunar mansions, containing 100 stars, one of which is λ Aquarii.
E.
शत a hundred, भिषज् to cure, aff. ड; requiring many physicians; as the Hindus say DHANVANTARI himself cannot cure any person affected with disease, whilst the moon is in this asterism.

f. (-रुः)
Arabian jasmine, (J. zambac.)
E.
शत a hundred (dangers), भीरु timid.

m. (-स्वः)
INDRA.
E.
शत a hundred, and मख a sacrifice: the performance of a hundred Aśvamedhas obtaining this situation.

m. (-न्युः)
INDRA.
E.
शत a hundred, and मन्यु a sacrifice; see the last.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 A Pala of silver.
2 An Āḍhaka or measure so termed.
E.
शत a hundred, and मान measure.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Bought with the measure of one hundred.
E.
शत a hundred, मान measure, and अण् aff.

m. (-री)
A man who has killed a hundred others.
E.
शत, and मारिन् a killer.

m. (-र्जः)
An armourer, a cutler.
E.
शत a hundred, (many, weapons,) and मार्ज who cleans.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
1 Having a hundred mouths.
2 Having a hundred openings or outlets.
E.
शत, and मुस्व mouth.

f. (-ली)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
E.
शत a hundred or many, मूल a root, fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added शतमूलिका.

m. (-कः)
A necklace of 100 strings.
E.
शत a hundred, यष्टि a string, कन् added.

n. (-क्षं)
A hundred Lakhs, ten millions.
E.
शत, and लक्ष a hundred thousand.

m. (-कः)
A name of the poet BHĀRAVI.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
Of a hundred years, a century old.
n. (-र्षं)
A century.
E.
शत, and वर्ष a year.

f. (-र्य्या)
White Dūb grass, (Panicum dactylon with white blossoms.)
E.
शत a hundred, वीय्य seed.

m. (-धी)
A sort of dock or sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha or Rumex vesicarius.)
E.
शत a hundred, व्यध to pierce, aff. णिनि.

ind.
By hundreds, a hundred fold.
E.
शत, and शसि aff.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
1 Having many branches.
2 Multiform, various.
E.
शत, and शाखा a branch.

n. (-स्रं)
A hundred thousand.
E.
शत, and सहस्र a thousand.

mfn. (-स्रः-स्री-स्रं)
Having a hundred thousand, bought with, consisting of, &c.
E.
शतसहस्र, and अण् aff.

ind.
By myriads.
E.
शस् added to the last.

f. (-दा)
1 Lightning.
2 The thunderbolt.
E.
शत a hundred, ह्रद a ray of light, or ह्राद sound, and the vowel made short; read also, शतह्रादा.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Hundred eyed.
f. (-क्षी)
1 Night.
2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa).
3 The goddess PĀRVATĪ.
E.
शत a hundred, अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A car, a chariot.
E.
शत a hundred, and अङ्ग a part.

n. (-कं)
A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a burial ground, a cemetery.
E.
शत a hundred, आनक a drum.

m. (-न्दः)
1 BRAHMĀ.
2 VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
3 The car of VIṢṆU.
4 The Muni GAUTAMA, the founder of the logical school of philosophy.
5 The eldest son of GAUTAMA, (according to the Rāmāyaṇa,) and Purohita or religious adviser of JANAKA of Mithila.
E.
शत a hundred or many, and आनन्द who delights.

m. (-न्दः)
The sage GAUTAMA, the author of the Nyāya or logical philosophy.
E.
सत् the good, and आनन्द who delights.

m. (-कः)
1 An old man.
2 The name of a sovereign, the son and successor of JANAMEJAYA.
3 The name of a saint, the pupil of VYĀSA.
E.
शत a hundred, आङ् before नी to obtain, कप् aff.

m. (-युः)
A man a hundred years old, an old man.
E.
शत, and आयुस् life.

n. (-रं)
The thunderbolt.
E.
शत a hundred, ऋ to go, aff. अण्.

nf. (-रुः-रुषी)
A leprous disease of the skin.
E.
शत hundred or many, and अरुस् a sore.

f. (-र्णा)
A plant, (Anethum sowa.)

m. (-रः)
A fine of a hundred (Paṇas, &c.)
E.
शत, and अवर inferior.

f. (-री)
1 A shrub, (Asparagus racemosus.)
2 The wife of INDRA.
E.
शत a hundred (roots), आङ् before वृ to choose, aff. अच्.

m. (-र्त्तः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving.

m. (-र्त्ती)
VIṢṆU.
E.
शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving, (appearances, or in the mind of his worshippers), इनि aff.

f. (-ह्वा-ह्वी)
A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.)
E.
शत a hundred, and आह्ना name, appellation.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Indicative of a hundred, (as a sign or omen.)
2 Doing or effecting any thing with a hundred.
3 Bearing tax or interest per hundred.
4 Bought with a hundred.
5 Changed with or for a hundred, &c.
6 Relating or belonging to a hundred.
E.
शत a hundred, and ठक or ठञ् or ठन् aff.; also with यत् aff. शत्य in the same acceptations.

m. (-रः)
1 An enemy.
2 Injury, detriment, hurt.
E.
शद to decay, to go, Uṇādi aff. एरक, and द changed to त.

m. (-शः)
The ruler or head man of a hundred (villages).
E.
शत, and ईश sovereign.

m. (-त्त्रिः)
An elephant.
E.
शद to go, त्त्रिप् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-त्त्रिः)
1 A cloud.
2 An elephant.
3 A victor, a conqueror.
E.
षद to go, or waste, to destroy, &c. Uṇādi aff. त्रि.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Bought with a hundred, &c. see शतिक.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
1 True.
2 Sincere, honest, speaking the truth.
n. (-त्यं)
1 Truth.
2 An oath.
3 The first Yuga or age, the golden age, comprising one million seven hundred and twenty-eight thousand years.
4 Demonstrated conclusion.
m. (-त्यः)
1 RĀMACANDRA.
2 The uppermost of the seven Lokas or worlds, the abode of BRAHMĀ, and heaven of truth.
f. (-त्या)
1 SĪTĀ, the wife of RĀMA.
2 The mother of Vyāsa.
3 Speaking the truth, sincerity, veracity.
ind. (सत्यम्)
Indeed, verily, a particle of interrogation, and asseveration.
E.
सत् being, and यत् aff.

m. (-त्रः)
1 An enemy, a foe, an adversary.
2 A political enemy, a neighbouring prince as being one with whom disputes are likely to occur.
E.
शद to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रुन्.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Bearing or patient with an enemy.
E.
शत्रु, सह to bear, खच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Who beats or kills an enemy.
E.
शत्रु, and घात who kills.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Killing a foe.
m. (-घ्नः)
The second brother of RĀMACANDRA, the son of SUMITRĀ, and uterine brother of LAKṢMAṆA.
E.
शत्रु an enemy, and घ्न destroyer.

f. (-नी)
SUMITRĀ, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA, and ŚATRUGHNA.
E.
शत्रुघ्न ŚATRUGHNA, and जननी the mother.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Subduing an enemy.
m. (-यः)
1 The mountain Vimala, or Girnār, or a mountainous range in Guzerat.
2 An elephant.
E.
शत्रु a foe, जि to conquer, खच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Hostility, enmity.
E.
तल् added to शत्रु; also शत्रुत्वं.

m. (-यः)
A number or host of enemies.
E.
शत्रु, and निकाय a quantity.

m. (-यः)
The dwelling of a foe.
E.
शत्रु, and निलय abode.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Humbling or subduing enemies.
E.
शत्रु, तप to harass, खच् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
An antagonist, an enemy.
E.
शत्रु, and पक्ष side or part.

m. (-नः)
ŚATRUGHNA, the brother of RĀMA.
E.
शत्रु a foe, मर्द्दन destroyer.

f. (-री)
Night.
E.
शद to go, क्वरप् aff.; fem. aff. ङीप्.

n. (-म्भं)
Gold.
E.
अण् pleonasm, added to the last.

n. (-नं)
Withering, decaying, becoming thin or small.
E.
शो to wither, aff. ल्युट्, form irr.

f. (-की)
Moonlight.
E.
शतपत्र a lotus, कन् added, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Relating to INDRA.
E.
शतमन्यु, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Sharp pointed, (as the nails, &c.)
E.
शात, and शिखा crest.

f. (-री)
A woman with a small belly or waist.
E.
शात, and उदर the belly, ङीप् aff.

m. (-वः)
An enemy.
n. (-वं)
1 Enmity, hostility.
2 A multitude of enemies.
E.
शत्रु an enemy, and अण् pleonasm, or aff. of quality or number.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Hostile, inimical, belonging or relating to an enemy.
E.
शात्रव, and छ aff.

n. (-त्वं)
The substitution of the letters ष or ण for स, and न in grammatical derivatives.
E.
ष and ण the letters, with the abstract affix attached to each respectively.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relative to the substitution of ष or ण for स and न, (as a rule, &c.)
E.
ठक् added to षत्वणत्व as above.

mfn. (-सन्-सती-सत्)
1 True.
2 Good, virtuous.
3 Being, existing.
4 Excellent, best.
5 Venerable, respectable.
6 Wise, learned.
7 Firm, steady.
8 Right, proper.
f. (-सती)
1 A virtuous wife; in ordinary use applied especially to the wife who burns herself with her husband's corpse.
2 The goddess UMĀ.
3 A fragrant earth, commonly Surat earth.
4 A species of the Pratiṣṭhā metre.
n. (सत्)
The true God, the always present and all-pervading spirit.
ind. (सत्)
In composition, a particle of reverence or respect, implying, good, right, fit, &c. as सत्क्रिया virtue, doing what is right, &c.
E.
अस to be, aff. of the participle of the present tense शतृ.

n. (सात्)
BRAHMA, GOD.
E.
साति to cause happiness, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Eternal, continual.
n. adv. (-तं)
Eternally, continually.
E.
सम् before तन to spread, aff. क्त, and the म rejected optionally.

n. (-त्त्वं)
Natural property, nature.
E.
स for समान universal, तत्त्व nature.

f. (-तिः)
1 End, destruction.
2 Gift, giving.
E.
षण to give or षो to destroy, क्तिन् aff.; also साति.

f. (-तिः)
1 End, conclusion, cessation of action.
2 Destruction.
3 Gift, giving.
4 Sharp pain.
E.
षो to destroy, or षण् to give, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.; also read सति and सन्ति.

n. (-त्वं)
Virtuousness or purity in a wife.
E.
सती, see सत्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, सतीता.

m. (-नः)
Peas, or a particular kind of pulse.
E.
सति, from सत् being, life, इन् master, and with कन् added सतीनक.

m. (-कः)
Peas; also सितीनक, and सतीलक, &c.: see the last.

m. (-र्थः)
A fellow student, the pupil of the same spiritual preceptor.
E.
स for सह same, तीर्थ a teacher.

m. (-र्थ्यः)
A fellow student: see the last.
E.
स for सह the same, तीर्थ a teacher, and यत् aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A bambu.
2 Air, wind.
mf. (-लः-ला)
Peas, pulse, or a particular kind, called Teorā.
E.
सती a good wife, लक्ष to make, aff. ड.

m. (-कः)
Pulse in general, or a particular sort.
E.
सतील wind, कै to utter, aff. ड; also सितीलक, सतीनक, सातीलक.

m. (-कः)
Peas; also सतीलक, सतीनक, &c.

mfn. (-तृट्)
1 Thirsty, greedy, cupidinous.
2 Thirsty, (literally.)
E.
स for सहित with, तृष thirst, literally or figuratively.

n. (-र्म्म)
1 A good act, piety, virtue.
2 Hospitality.
3 Funeral obsequies.
4 Expiation.
E.
सत्, and कम्मन् act; also सत्, क्रिया, &c.

m. (-म्बः)
A tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.)
E.
सत् good, कदम्ब the Cadamba tree.

m. (-रः)
A sort of ebony: see रक्तकाञ्चन.

m. (-ण्डः)
A hawk, a kite.

m. (-रः)
1 Reverence, respect.
2 Hospitable treatment or reception.
E.
सत्, and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Worshipped, adored.
2 Respected, revered.
3 Welcomed, saluted.
4 Entertained, treated with hospitality.
5 Done rightly or properly.
n. (-तं)
1 Hospitality.
2 Respect.
3 Virtue.
E.
सत् excellent, and कृत made.

f. (-तिः)
1 Doing good, acting properly, virtue, morality, &c.
2 Treating with respect.
E.
सत् good, and कृति act.

ind.
Having treated with respect, &c.
E.
सत्, and कृत्य having made.

f. (-या)
1 Funeral or obsequial ceremonies.
2 Any purificatory ceremony.
3 Doing good, charity, virtue, &c.
4 Worship, homage.
5 Respectful treatment.
6 Salutation, welcome, courtesy.
7 Hospitality.
E.
सत् good, and क्रिया act.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Best, excellent.
2 Very venerable or respectable.
3 Most virtuous.
E.
सत् good, and तमप् aff.

r. 10th cl. (सत्रयते)
1 To act liberally.
2 To be connected.
3 To spread or extend.

n. (-त्रं)
Sacrifice, &c.; see सत्त्र.

n. (-त्त्रं)
1 Sacrifice, oblation.
2 Liberality, munificence.
3 Covering, clothing, concealing.
4 Fraud, roguery, cheating.
5 A wood, a forest.
6 Wealth.
7 A house.
8 A tank, a pond.
E.
सद to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्; in writing, one त may be omitted, and it occurs, सत्र.

ind.
With, together with.
E.
स for सह with, त्रा to preserve, aff. क्विप्; also written, सत्रा.

f. (-ला)
